scope: Generate and integrate an iOS app icon for the RAI running and training app.

asset.palette: pearl silver, ice cyan, pale lavender highlights, deep indigo background; no orange or gold

verification.build_command: xcodebuild -project RAI.xcodeproj -scheme RAI -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath /tmp/rai-appicon-build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build -quiet

not_verified: Physical iPhone home screen appearance and masking.
Dark and tinted alternate icon appearances.
